config.name: RORgamma LBD + inverse agonist 4P1 (steer to H12-out)
why: The money direction: inverse agonism is the therapeutic state (Th17
suppression), and it is the under-represented state -- apo RORgamma and
most agonist structures sit H12-in, so co-folding models should default
there. 4ZJW's derived region is a single pure-H12 segment (479-486),
which makes the state call unusually clean for a non-kinase.

3KYT.note: ACTIVE reference. Canonical agonist conformation, agonist lock H479-Y502-F506 packed. Empirically confirmed as the displaced-against state.

4ZJW.note: INACTIVE reference. Displacement profile vs 3KYT is a single H12-localised segment 479-486 (max 10.6 A), nothing else moves. Chain A kept (carries the ligand).

5IXK.note: alternative inactive ref: H12 478-487 plus loops 310-314/392-394, max 10.1 A. Use for sensitivity, not primary (loops dilute the region).

5NTK.note: alternative inactive ref: H12 476-489, max 24.5 A (swung-out helix). Extreme case; use as sensitivity check.

4ZJR.ligand: inverse agonist with H12 still packed
4ZJR.note: STATE-FUNCTION DECOUPLING DECOY: inverse agonist 4P3 but H12 stays in the agonist position (max 4.9 A, 'same state' warning). Do NOT use as the inactive reference. The scorer must call it H12-in -- if it does, that is a pitch slide.

config._sequence_note: Full LBD construct read from 3KYT chain A (243 res, 265-507). Set explicitly so the inverse-agonist entry folds the complete H12 even though the 4ZJW crystal construct truncates at 486.
config._smiles_note: 4P1 from RCSB chemcomp REST (rcsb_chem_comp_descriptor). Achiral (InChIKey NWECRSKQCPBSPW-UHFFFAOYSA-N).
config._state_region_note: H12 segment from the 3KYT-vs-4ZJW displacement profile (threshold 2.0 A). Starts at the agonist-lock His479. Sensitivity alternatives: [286,287,288,290] + this set (full auto region), or range(470, 508) (full H12 window).
config._back_pocket_note: State-specific 4P1 contacts (4ZJW numbering = canonical): 480 sits IN H12, 396/401 on the back-pocket side, 362 adjacent to the R364/R367 sulfate pocket. Derived by make_inputs --show-pocket, pasted 2026-10-01.

arms.desc: default inference, full MSA, no steering
pocket conditioned on state-SPECIFIC contacts (the hypothesis)
NEGATIVE CONTROL: pocket conditioned on contacts shared by both states -- should not flip the state
NEGATIVE CONTROL: template of the WRONG state -- if this also lands on the target state, the model is ignoring the template and you are measuring memorisation
MSA-free: removes the evolutionary prior that pulls the model to the dominant state
DIAGNOSTIC: target-state pocket vs WRONG-state template. Which lever wins tells you their relative strength
OpenFold3 with target-state template (CIF direct mode)
